description: Parallel research, a human plan decision, and an independently reviewed local deployment.

research-code.prompt:
Read task.md, duration.py, and test_duration.py. Identify the cause,
the allowed file change, and evidence from the test. Write only your
step report in the run directory.

research-rules.prompt:
Read task.md. List the acceptance checks, edit scope, conditions that
block deployment, and rollback. Write only your step report in the
run directory.

plan.prompt:
Read task.md and research-code.md, research-rules.md, and reproduce.txt
in {{run_dir}}. Write plan.md in the run directory using both reports.
Include the edit scope, exact test command, destination, rollback,
and both review points. Apply the operator comment on a revised attempt.
Write only the plan file in the run directory.

review-plan.prompt:
Compare task.md with {{run_dir}}/plan.md independently. Review the
scope, test, human decision, candidate review, deployment, and rollback.
Compute the SHA-256 of the exact plan bytes you reviewed.
Write {{run_dir}}/review-plan.md as JSON with the keys verdict (PASS or
BLOCK), subject_sha256 (the plan digest), and reason (a nonempty string).
Write only this report and put the JSON directly in it. A completed
review can report either verdict.

gate.question: Approve this plan, or send it back for revision?

fix.prompt:
Read task.md, plan.md, approved-plan.json, and reproduce.txt. The last
three files are in {{run_dir}}. Edit only duration.py and write a short
step report. Leave the Git index and test alone. The next step reruns
the test and records its result.

review-deploy.prompt:
Read task.md and plan.md, fix.diff, candidate.json, reproduce.txt, and
verify-candidate.txt in {{run_dir}}. Review the diff, test evidence,
deployment destination, and rollback. Compute the SHA-256 of the
exact candidate.json bytes you reviewed. Write only
{{run_dir}}/review-deploy.md as JSON with verdict (PASS or BLOCK),
subject_sha256 (the candidate digest), and reason (a nonempty string).
Put the JSON directly in the report.
